queries.privacy: union isfuzzy=true AppEvents,ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL,ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated>=datetime(2026-10-16T13:35:00Z) | extend row=tostring(pack_all()) | summarize checkedRows=count(),sentinelLeaks=countif(row contains 'OLDWEB_ADMIN_PRIVACY_SENTINEL_20261010' or row contains 'OLDWEB_ADMIN_SECRET_SENTINEL_20261010')
queries.internalTools: AppEvents | where Name=='mcp_activity' and TimeGenerated>=datetime(2026-10-16T13:35:00Z) and tostring(Properties.internal)=='true' and tostring(Properties.method)=='tools/call' | summarize calls=count() by service=tostring(Properties.service),outcome=tostring(Properties.outcome)
